title: NHS England regions, July 2022 (England, generalised, clipped)
description: The seven regions NHS England is organised into, above the integrated care boards.

files.note: Exported from the Open Geography Portal feature service "NHS_England_Regions_July_2022_EN_BGC_2022" (https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/NHS_England_Regions_July_2022_EN_BGC_2022/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson), 7 features in WGS84. The portal serves this product through the API rather than as a named download, so the file is named for the layer and reproduced by rerunning that query rather than by filename.
